Merges Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) family and individual files
into a wide-format panel data set. The user obtains the files from the
PSID data center; the package does not download data and does not handle
credentials. Files are imported once with getPSID(), which uses the
'SAScii' package to read the SAS layout files, and the panel is built
with build.panel(). It is a fork of 'psidR' by Florian Oswald.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`build.panel()`](build.panel.md) : build.panel: Build PSID panel data
  set
- [`build.psid()`](build.psid.md) : Build example PSID
- [`extendVarsPSID()`](extendVarsPSID.md) : Extend a PSID variable list
  to new waves using the crosswalk
- [`get.psid()`](get.psid.md) : get.psid connects to PSID database and
  downloads into Rda
- [`getFamilyPSID()`](getFamilyPSID.md) : Import locally downloaded PSID
  family files
- [`getIndPSID()`](getIndPSID.md) : Import locally downloaded PSID
  individual files
- [`getNamesPSID()`](getNamesPSID.md) : GetPSID variables names from
  various years
- [`getPSID()`](getPSID.md) : Import locally downloaded PSID family and
  individual files
- [`localpsidR-package`](localpsidR.md) [`localpsidR`](localpsidR.md) :
  localpsidR
- [`make.char()`](make.char.md) : Convert factor to character
- [`makeids()`](makeids.md) : ID list for mergeing PSID
- [`medium.test.ind.NA()`](medium.test.ind.NA.md) : three year test, ind
  file and one NA variable
- [`medium.test.ind.NA.wealth()`](medium.test.ind.NA.wealth.md) : three
  year test, ind file and one NA variable and wealth
- [`medium.test.ind()`](medium.test.ind.md) : three year test, ind file
- [`medium.test.noind()`](medium.test.noind.md) : three year test, no
  ind file
- [`processPSID()`](processPSID.md) : Import locally downloaded PSID
  files
- [`small.test.ind()`](small.test.ind.md) : one year test, ind file
- [`small.test.noind()`](small.test.noind.md) : one year test, no ind
  file
- [`testPSID()`](testPSID.md) : Create a test PSID dataset
